scenarios.name: extrusion-12a Inspect the Distance A editor menu

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software is displaying a part in the solid modeling workspace

scenario_steps.name: a copy of `fixtures/cad/extrusion/extrusion-rect-8mm.opd` is open with Edit Feature active
the user opens the Distance A editor menu
it offers Measure, Select Feature Dimension, Parameters, Tolerance and List Parameters
a list of parameters available in the active part appears
the user dismisses the list and clicks Cancel
the extrusion edit closes without changing the feature
